summary_en: 1,200,000 shares acquisition authorized at ¥1,000M ceiling (1.49% of 80,520,639 ex-treasury shares), Aug 7–31, 2026, via open market purchase on TSE. Concurrent cancellation of 900,000 shares (1.11% pre-cancel) effective Sep 11, 2026. Stated rationale: capital efficiency and shareholder returns as part of sustained growth and mid-to-long-term enterprise value enhancement.
title_en: Notice of Resolution Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, Asanuma Corporation's Board of Directors approved a treasury stock acquisition and cancellation program under the Company Act. The company will acquire up to 1,200,000 ordinary shares (1.49% of the 80,520,639 ex-treasury shares outstanding as of 31 July 2026) for a total outlay not exceeding ¥1,000 million. The acquisition will be conducted via open market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 7 to 31 August 2026. Concurrently, the Board approved the cancellation of 900,000 treasury shares (1.11% of issued shares including treasury), effective 11 September 2026. The company stated that the program supports its strategy to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns as part of long-term enterprise value growth and to improve market valuation through greater awareness of capital cost and stock price.
